module.title: Booking resources
module.description: Bookable resources, seat maps and capacities

seating.modeHelp: Pool: N interchangeable places per slot. Seat map: numbered seats, customers pick exact seats (cinema/theater).
seating.capacityHelp: Pool capacity per slot. In seat-map mode the active seat count is what effectively limits a showing.
seating.generatorHint: Regenerating keeps existing seats (sold tickets stay valid) and deactivates seats outside the new grid — nothing is deleted.
seating.emptyHint: No seats yet — generate a grid above.
seating.toggleHint: Click a seat to deactivate/activate it (pillars, wheelchair spaces, broken seats). Save to apply.
